name: Prawn Teriyaki Noodles
method: Cook the noodles following the packet instructions, drain and set aside. Heat half the oil in a wok and scramble the eggs for 1 minute, then break up and tip onto a plate.
Heat the remaining oil, add the stir-fry veg and cook over a high heat for 4 minutes until just tender.
Add the prawns and heat through for 2 minutes until piping hot, then add the noodles, teriyaki sauce and soy sauce and toss for 2 minutes.
Stir the eggs back in, divide between bowls and scatter over the chopped nuts to serve.
